**Reasoning:** The test image shows tomato leaves covered with very small dark specks scattered uniformly across the surface, with yellow chlorotic patches and some brown necrosis. The Bugwood_6 reference confirms the characteristic pattern of small black spots with yellow margins on green tomato leaves. Septoria spots are typically larger with tan/gray centers; TSWV shows rings rather than specks.
